concern: (low) Navigation link padding (p-1) should be expanded on mobile touch viewports to guarantee 44x44px touch target compliance per Fitts's Law
jtbd: When navigating the platform on a mobile touchscreen viewport (<=375px), I want interactive navigation links to provide an adequate touch target dimension (minimum 44x44px), so that I can reliably tap links without misclicks or perceptual frustration per Fitts's Law.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a mobile touch viewport of 375px or smaller, When inspecting the navigation anchor elements in the header <nav>, Then each link has touch target bounding box dimensions of at least 44x44px (e.g. via responsive padding py-3 px-3 md:p-1 and inline-flex items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]), satisfying WCAG 2.5.5 / 2.5.8 target size criteria.
editInstruction: In design/approved/20261117105520-mockup/mockup.html, locate the <nav role="navigation" aria-label="Main Navigation"> element inside <header>. Update the class attribute of each <a ...> navigation link by replacing 'rounded-sm p-1' with 'rounded-md min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] inline-flex items-center justify-center px-3 py-2.5 md:p-1' to guarantee at least 44x44px physical touch target dimensions on mobile touch viewports.

concern: (low) Preset archetype dropdown retains generic FinTech label rather than CRIE normative knowledge base domain nomenclature
jtbd: When selecting or reviewing the target archetype in the control parameters form, I want the dropdown options and labels to reflect FBUN CRIE normative knowledge base terminology rather than a generic boilerplate FinTech label, so that the domain context is coherent and accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the control parameters form on the page, When inspecting the <select id="project-archetype-select"> element and surrounding archetype badges, Then the options and labels display domain-specific CRIE nomenclature (e.g., <option value="CRIE_NORMATIVE_KB" selected>CRIE Normative Knowledge Base</option>) instead of FinTech or FIN_TECH.
